Skills.Name: Acrobatics
Skills.Description: Athletic finesse — the foundation of evasive movement. Owning this tree unlocks individual acrobatic powers.

Powers.Name: Dodge
Powers.Description: +2 DV — always alert; harder to land a hit on you.

Powers.Name: Tumble
Powers.Description: Active ability: swap positions with an adjacent creature. Hostile targets get dazed (Confused 1T); allies just trade places. No weapon required. 20-turn cooldown.

Powers.Name: Evasive Roll
Powers.Description: Active ability: roll free of one negative status effect on yourself (priority: Stunned > Frozen > Paralyzed > Bleeding > others). 60-turn cooldown.

Powers.Name: Vault
Powers.Description: Choose a visible tile within 2 cells. Leap to an empty tile, or land one cell short of a creature and make one melee strike. Red outlines the attack target; yellow outlines your landing. The landing must be clear. Gain +2 accuracy for one adjacent melee roll, spent even on a miss; unused poise lasts 2 turns. Landing hazards still apply. Cooldown 15.
